ideas.idea: Fetch blog posts in a server component and give each post its own page/URL
ideas.why: The blog only renders titles client-side from /api/posts, so server rendering and per-post pages would put real content in HTML and give crawlers separate addresses.

ideas.idea: Expand docs with real setup steps in text
ideas.why: docs/page.tsx has a single sentence under a 'How to set up Ledger' description, so real steps would give people and machines something to read and quote.

ideas.idea: Spell out pricing plans in text, then label them with JSON-LD
ideas.why: The pricing page only says 'Free for up to three people' and has no structured data, so stating the plans first gives something concrete to mark up.

ideas.idea: Add short paragraphs on invoices, expenses and reports on the home page, linking to docs
ideas.why: The home page is one sentence and has no in-body links, so this would explain the product and add internal links.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to sitemap entries once real dates exist
ideas.why: This is accurate, but it applies to almost any sitemap and has little effect, and the report itself says to add dates only once they are available.

ideas.idea: If pricing is meant to be found, remove noindex; otherwise drop it from the sitemap and keep the nav link
ideas.why: This repeats the known pricing noindex problem instead of adding a new recommendation.

ideas.idea: Put the blog's canonical in a server layout.tsx, since it is a client component
ideas.why: The blog has no metadata export and a client component can't export metadata, so the layout workaround is specific and correct.
